provenance: Generated by scripts/bench-threshold-trade.mjs. False positives counted on real scientific abstracts (biomedical, so the rate OVERSTATES what AI-domain submissions would see); recall counted on real published prose with one content word removed, excluding mutations that yield another valid glossary term. This is a trade to DECIDE, not an optimum to compute - the two sides are not commensurable and the owner picks the point.
provenance_note: Generated in the pipeline's original private deployment. The false-positive corpus is public (SciFact abstracts, fetch with scripts/fetch-benchmarks.mjs); the recall half used a private prose corpus, so the generating script does not ship. The numbers stand as recorded; reproducing the FP sweep needs only the public corpus.
